description: Defines a REST API exception handler class for centralized exception handling in a Spring Boot application, returning structured JSON error responses with appropriate HTTP status codes.

classes.name: RestExceptionHandler
classes.description: Centralized exception handler for REST controllers, mapping exceptions to HTTP responses with error details.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException, returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException, returning a 400 Bad Request with validation error details.

methods.name: handleConstraintViolation
methods.description: Handles ConstraintViolationException, returning a 400 Bad Request with validation error message.

methods.name: handleErrorResponseException
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException, returning the response with the exception's status and message.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with error details.
